'''Lisa West''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Chatswood tournament]] on 3 June 2001 with podracing with Watto's Box, according to Jake Canns's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2402">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-02-nsw-chatswood-3-06-01d2402/ nsw-chatswood-3-06-01], DeckTech (Jake "BladeBoy®" Canns, 2 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-02-nsw-chatswood-3-06-01d2402/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
